actions.description: Pipettes hanging on rack; gloved hand reaches for rightmost/yellow-top pipette.
Pipette is removed from rack and moved toward the bench/tip box area.
Pipette tip is positioned over/into a red tip box; appears to seat or pick up a tip.
Pipette remains at the red tip box with tip in/near tip positions; no liquid aspiration/dispense visible.
Pipette is lifted away from tip box and moved back toward rack.
Pipette is returned to rack with a long tip/nozzle visible.

reuse.evidence: No aspiration/dispense into different media or reuse across samples is visible.

surface.evidence: Tip is not visibly touching a bench, glove, tube exterior, or other non-sterile surface before use.

release.evidence: No tip is visibly dropped, ejected, or released unexpectedly.

install.evidence: The pipette is placed into a red tip box and later has a long tip/nozzle visible, but the frames do not clearly show whether the tip is correctly seated or whether it is the wrong size.

output.overall_summary: The visible clip shows a pipette being taken from the rack, positioned in a tip box, then returned to the rack. No visible aspiration/dispense or clear technique error is shown; tip installation quality is not clear from the frames.
